changes: Replaced chronology-reversing raw edges with the official UNRATE comparison and range rule.
Separated the prior observation, target observation, absolute-change calculation, and measured change.
Removed forecast surprise and payroll-employment links that do not determine the benchmark unemployment-rate change.
Retained one actual outcome node as the sink.
caveats: Contemporaneous reports cite a smaller preliminary May-to-June change than the benchmark snapshot; the refined graph follows the official snapshotted value used for resolution.
Because the benchmark evidence summary does not list the two underlying rates, both rate-observation nodes are evidence-synthesized.
